physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the throat, in the thyroid and the larynx, the narrow place between the head and the heart where everything has to pass. The thyroid sets the pace of the body's chemistry, slow or fast, warm or cold, the metabolism by which a person moves through their days. The larynx shapes breath into a voice. Both sit in the same small stretch of the neck. It is fitting. This is the code of guarded warmth and pure heart, and the throat is the gate they share.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. When the wall the keys section spoke of is up, the throat is where it stands. Words come out a little cooler than the feelings behind them. The voice runs in the top of the chest and does not drop. Swallowing tightens. The thyroid takes the weight of the held-back life and lets it show as flatness, chill, a slowness no rest quite cures. The body keeps the secret the mouth is keeping.

The climb out is also bodily, and it sounds. Warmth comes back into the voice before the mind has agreed to drop the guard. The throat softens, the breath drops lower, and what gets said begins to match what is felt. Other people hear it before they can name what changed. The purity this card moves toward is not an idea about purity. It is a tone. It enters the room through this one narrow place.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the gland, this code answers to no amino acid at all. In the language of the genetic code there are three stop codons, the punctuation marks that tell the cell the sentence is finished and the protein is complete. This card is one of them. Where the other sixty-three codes build a letter into the body's chemistry, this one writes the ending.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the strange one at the centre of this card. The wall the shadow builds, the careful holding back, is a sentence the body keeps trying to extend past its own ending. The code is a full stop. When it is finally allowed to fall, the carefully managed self the keys section described simply stops being constructed. Nothing further is added. The chemistry says the same thing the siddhi says, lower down than any teaching. To arrive at purity is not to make something new. It is to let the sentence end.
